Jpmorgan Chase & Company decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 4.27% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 52.76M shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $8.09B, down from 55.12 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Jpmorgan Chase & Company who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $897.80 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.09% or $1.91 during the last trading session, reaching $176.94. About 23.77 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 62.48% since March 9, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 45.78% the S&P500.
Jpmorgan Chase & Company, which manages about $453.26B US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Citrix Sys Inc (NASDAQ:CTXS) by 314,692 shares to 2.68M shares, valued at $205.72 million in 2017Q3, according to the filing.
